CVE-2016-4171 Adobe Flash Zero-day used in targeted attacks

As a person who uses his computer to play a few games and primarily to surf the Internet, I uninstalled Flash over a year ago, and pretty much any website worth crap will default to an HTML5 video. There are a few that defiantly tell me to install Flash, but if I set the User Agent to an iPad, the site will send me the HTML5 video.

Moral to the story: Uninstall Flash. Unless you have some critical app that requires it, you don't need the security hole.
